# React Bits exports used by Đông A EDU

Copyright (c) 2026 David Haz. The upstream MIT + Commons Clause notice is retained in [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). These exports are used within this application; the React Bits editors and sound library are not distributed as tools or an asset product.

- Sound Lab (retired): the Breeze effect, its runtime playback module, and the two bundled MP3 clips have been removed at the user's request. Cloud separators are silent. [breeze-settings.json](breeze-settings.json) remains as a provenance record of the former export; it is not shipped by the app.
- Shape Magic: `lib/cloud-morph.ts` adapts the SVG morph timing from the official [vector exporter](https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/tools/shape-magic/export/vector.js). The application's own cloud paths retain matching segment counts and seam endpoints. `section-cloud.tsx` uses SVG path morphing, moving gradient gloss, and bevel outlines in the site's pale gold palette; it does not load a WebGL editor. Motion is mounted only near visible desktop sections and is omitted on phones and with Reduced Motion.
- Metallic Paint: `components/react-bits/metallic-paint.web.tsx` adapts the official [TypeScript component](https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/ts-default/Animations/MetallicPaint/MetallicPaint.tsx), whose liquid-metal shader is described by React Bits as adapted from Paper. Local changes accept a measured DOM text canvas, report readiness/failure, use inline styling and a span host, cap animation at 30 fps, observe page visibility, and attach pointer tracking to the containing word so text selection still works. `hero-title.web.tsx` shares the measured Manrope renderer and the original SVG brand mask between the main hero and closing invitation. The original logo outlines come from `assets/logo.jpg` via `constants/brand.ts` and `components/brand-wordmark.tsx`; the brand is not recreated with a substitute font. Accessible text and visible SVG remain beneath transparent canvas overlays at 70% opacity, with the application's white/red palette, speed 0.32 and low dispersion; the closing “Đông A” uses the same red logo outlines as the hero. Phone/Reduced Motion/native render static text, and WebGL failures retain the same visible heading. The existing upstream [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) applies.

- Threads: `components/react-bits/threads.web.tsx` adapts the official [TypeScript source](https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/ts-default/Backgrounds/Threads/Threads.tsx). Inline styles replace its CSS import, render dimensions are capped at 1280px, and painting is capped at 30fps; upstream visibility pausing and resource cleanup are retained. The current compact wrapper uses logo red/gold, 14 lines, amplitude 0.45, thickness 0.7, speed 0.18, angle 0, fade 0 and 20% host opacity. `threaded-wave-band.tsx` confines it to exactly two 24px wave bands: below the hero and at the start of the shared footer. It no longer decorates the campaign or footer body and does not intercept input. Mobile/native/Reduced Motion render static SVG lines instead. The existing upstream license applies.
- Rimmed clouds: both the downward cloud at the closing invitation and upward cloud after the intro video now use the same Shape Magic morph timing (20 seconds). The upward cloud retains variant 1 and its upward orientation. All cloud separators remain silent.

Sources checked on 2026-10-30. Tool pages: [Sound Lab](https://reactbits.dev/tools/sound-lab), [Shape Magic](https://reactbits.dev/tools/shape-magic).
